scope.flow: Emergency pause coverage of escrow state transitions in TrustBonding/VotingEscrow
scope.environment: Smart contract (Solidity) protocol with inherited VotingEscrow

statements.text: TrustBonding inherits VotingEscrow entry points create_lock, increase_amount, increase_unlock_time and withdraw that do not consult paused().
The emergency pause flag is set on the contract during an incident.
A caller invokes create_lock or increase_amount or increase_unlock_time or withdraw while the pause flag is set.
Only claimRewards() is guarded by whenNotPaused, so the inherited escrow entry points remain live while paused.
Lock creation, lock modification and withdrawals cannot be frozen and keep executing while the pause flag is set.
Reward-relevant state keeps changing while operators believe the bonding contract is paused.
When the pause flag is set, invoking lock creation, lock modification or withdrawal should be blocked so escrow and reward-relevant state stays frozen.
Operators expect the emergency pause to freeze protocol state during an incident.

ambiguities: No attacker, motive or exploit path is described; the report frames this as an incomplete pause rather than an active attack.
Whether entry points are reachable directly on VotingEscrow versus only through TrustBonding is not stated.
No amounts, specific roles, asset values or transaction ordering are provided.
Whether paused() is exposed and callable as a view in VotingEscrow is not established.
Any economic loss or downstream consequence from changing reward-relevant state is not quantified.
